body.name: Data deletion enforced
body.description: Data is securely deleted when no longer needed.
body.detail: Case workspace data is deletable; ingested evidence deliberately is not.
observations: Cases cascade-delete their pinned entities and notes.
ingested_record is append-only on purpose: a hash chain that permits silent deletion is not tamper-evident. Removing a row breaks the chain, and /integrity/verify reports exactly where.
TENSION, STATED: retention-driven erasure therefore means disposing of a whole batch and recording the disposal, not editing rows. That procedure is the agency's to write.
